title: Letter - For Special Protection By Police To Japanese Residents

page_data.en:
S. B. D. 2588/5.
SHANGHAI JAPANESE AMALGAMATED
ASSOCIATION OF STREET UNIONS. 8-31
July 31, 1931.

To Commissioner of Police,
S. M. C.

Dear Sir,
I have the honour to express my sincere
thanks to you for the special protection accorded
(notwithstanding the increased volume of police work
at present) to the Japanese residents by the Shanghai
Municipal Police in detailing police officers to the
Japanese Club and other important places during this
feverish time of the anti-Japanese movement by the
Chinese.

Yours obediently,
Y. Hayashi.
Chairman of the Committee of
the Shanghai Japanese Amalgamated
Association of Street Unions.
page_data.zh:
S. B. D. 2588/5.
上海日本各街路同业公会联合会。8-31
1931年7月31日。

致警务处处长，
上海公共租界工部局。

尊敬的先生：
谨此向您致以诚挚的谢意，感谢上海公共租界警务处在中国人反日运动高涨之际，尽管目前警务工作繁重，仍特别派遣警员驻守日本俱乐部及其他重要场所，为日本居民提供特别保护。

此致
敬礼
林（Hayashi）Y.
上海日本各街路同业公会联合会委员会主席
